title: Kissed Moroccan Chickpeas Tagine
description: A winey, cheese‑pull Moroccan dish cooked in a clay pot, perfect for a solo dinner and free of onion and garlic.
instructions: Preheat clay pot over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add 1 tbsp olive oil and swirl until shimmering.
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and let it brown for 2 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and chopped apricots, then pour in 1 cup red wine and stir.
Pour in 2 cups vegetable broth, then add cooked chickpeas, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, cover the pot, and let it cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid, raise the heat, and let the sauce reduce until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
Sprinkle shredded aged cheddar over the top and replace the lid to melt, about 5 minutes.
Once the cheese has melted into a gooey layer, remove from heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the tagine straight from the clay pot or spoon into bowls, garnishing with fresh herbs if desired.
